messages:
laura: Heads-up — acme-inc opened a ticket: their A/B rollout dashboard is showing variant counts swapped. Screenshot indicates Control=8.1k, Treatment=2.0k but customer expects the opposite. Rollout id r-2026-02-14, cohort 'signup', last 24h. Can someone take a look?

michael: Can you confirm region and whether they're using the classic or new console? Also need the ticket id.

laura: EU region, new console. Ticket in CRM is ACME-998. Screenshot link: https://img.example/s/abc123.

support-bot: Created INC-4321 for ACME-998. Priority: P2.

eli: Running quick query against ab_assignments to verify raw assignment counts.

eli: ```sql
SELECT variant_key, count(*) as cnt
FROM ab_assignments
WHERE rollout_id = 'r-2026-02-14'
  AND ts >= now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY variant_key;
```

eli: Raw results: vA: 8129, vB: 2038 — so backend counts match customer expectation. UI must be mapping keys->labels incorrectly.

maya: FYI I rolled a small change 3h ago that uses the rollout.metadata.variants array to render labels. We had a fallback that used index order if the map was missing. If variant_keys order changed between model onboarding and rollout, labels could get swapped.

ops: Logs for metrics pipeline show emitted metrics with variant_key intact, so ingestion is fine. Likely a console rendering bug.

eli: Proposed plan:
1) Patch console to prefer explicit variant_key -> label mapping (no index fallback).
2) Hotfix the prod console (quick restart) to pick up patch.
3) Kick off backfill for rendered labels on metrics for past 7 days.

maya: I'll prepare the patch and open a canary PR. Hotfix ETA: 30m for canary, 1h for prod rollout after verification.

cs-lead: Please provide an ETA for customer communication and the backfill duration so I can update the ticket.

ops: Backfill estimate ~45 minutes for 7 days for this single rollout (batch job). Command we run: 
```
python tools/backfill_ab_labels.py --rollout r-2026-02-14 --days 7 --batch-size 100000
```

maya: Canary hotfix deployed; console rendering now uses explicit mapping on canary. Manual spot-checks look correct.

laura: Told customer we have a hotfix rolling and a backfill scheduled. Updated INC-4321.

support-bot: INC-4321 status changed: INVESTIGATING -> IN_PROGRESS.

eli: Starting backfill job bf-987 now; will post completion metrics.

ops: Backfill completed. Post-backfill verify query: 
```sql
SELECT rendered_label, sum(cnt) FROM ab_metrics
WHERE rollout_id='r-2026-02-14' AND ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY rendered_label;
```
Result (summary): Control: 2038, Treatment: 8129 — matches expected.

laura: Customer confirmed dashboard now shows expected counts. Marking INC-4321 as resolved from support side. :white_check_mark:

support-bot: INC-4321 status changed: IN_PROGRESS -> RESOLVED. Will auto-close in 24h if no reply.
